overview.text: The Chinese Green Snake is a slender, bright green, gentle snake of China and nearby countries. It rarely bites.

identification.text: Bright green above and greenish-yellow below, with smooth scales.

size.label: Adults
size.text: About 75 to 90 cm, sometimes up to 120 cm.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Central and southern China, Taiwan, northern Vietnam and Laos.

behaviour.text: Active by day and partly lives in trees and bushes.

diet.text: Earthworms, insect larvae and other soft-bodied invertebrates.

reproduction.text: Lays 2 to 16 eggs, which hatch after about two months.
